entries.requirement: avoid signed-integer overflow when validating a start offset combined with a count against a total length
clamp an excessive requested count to the remaining length instead of treating it as an error
express a sub-range using two absolute bounds instead of an offset-plus-count pair
reject an out-of-range start position unconditionally, not only in debug builds

Model a safe sub-range copy operation (like SoPath::copy(start, count)) over an indexed sequence, correctly handling an empty or out-of-range start, an excessive requested count, and the arithmetic needed to validate start+count without signed-integer overflow.
